name: SOAP_Rd_Trauttmansdorff_inv.nr.200_Kurtz_to_Trauttmansdorff_1639-04-22
current_holder: Státní oblastní archiv v Plzni, pracoviště Klášter u Nepomuka, Rodinný archiv Trauttmansdorffů, inv. nr. 200, karton nr. 9.
additional_information:
A contemporary decryption is attached (see the images behind the the images of the encrypted document).

The reconstructed key contains homophonic substitution, bigrams (one ciphertext character for one bigram) and nulls. The ciphertext characters are mostly numeric, less alphabetic (more Latin and less Greek alphabet) and there are also a few graphic signs. The language of the cleartext and the plaintext is Latin, but the text also contains a lot of German sentences or words.

For more information about the sender and receiver see e. g.:
Kurtz von Senftenau, Sigismund
Trauttmansdorff, Maximilian von

Related paper: MÍRKA, Jakub. Raně novověká šifrovaná korespondence ve fondech šlechtických rodinných archivů Státního oblastního archivu v Plzni. In: Západočeské archivy 2012, pp. 44–72.
author: Kurtz von Senftenau, Sigismund

name: Mögling, 'Speculum sophicum rhodo-stauroticum'
additional_information:
This rosicrucianism book with a title in Latin (English: The Mirror of the Wisdom of the Rosy Cross) in German has one page with ciphertext at the very beginning of the book. Salutation, command, introduction or ...? As far as is known, this has never been deciphered.

The complete book can be found at Zentralbibliothek Zürich, SCH R 201: https://www.e-manuscripta.ch/zuzneb/doi/10.7891/e-manuscripta-23267

Note that there are two copies of this book. Second copy: Zentralbibliothek Zürich, SCH C 1143. I only uploaded one of them. I have not checked if all the copies are identical!
